property_summary: For any owner-chosen logger address L and boolean b, after calling setApprovedLogger(L, b) the mapping approvedLoggers(L) equals b in the reference; the mutant inverts the stored value so approvedLoggers(L) == !b for some inputs, violating the rule.
change_summary: Inverted the assignment in setApprovedLogger to set the opposite boolean value, so callers intending to enable a logger will disable it and vice versa.
